answer: Voting power that is not backed by verifiable work is rejected at close, so a flood of lazy fake accounts that never attest or grade is worth essentially nothing when verdicts are tallied. The mechanism therefore aligns self-interest with network health: an attacker gains most by behaving honestly, because that is the only move that scales.. It survives because reputation is spent fast and earned slowly, so any alias that ever cheats loses value that is expensive to replace. Consider a sonnet as the anchor of the cost.
